gloss: to be frozen with fear; to have one's legs go weak

definitions.gloss: to be frozen with fear; to have one's legs go weak
definitions.explanation: To become unable to move one's legs due to fear, anxiety, or shock. Describes the physical sensation of legs becoming stiff or weak from fright.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{足|あし}がすくむ。
examples.english: My legs freeze up at high places.
My legs went weak when I stood at the top of the cliff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物音|ものおと}→物音：03633_monooto⟧がして、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧がすくんで⟦{動|うご}けなく→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I heard a noise in the dark alley and my legs froze, unable to move.

notes:
⟦すくむ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧ means to cower, stiffen, or become paralyzed with fear. This expression vividly describes the physical sensation of legs becoming stiff or weak from fright.
